held_in.text: units of a mutual fund, ordered through a distributor, a bank or TASE member with which the holder keeps a securities account, and held in that account (MF-11, BRK-01). A self-directed provident or study fund may hold units too (IRA-11), and there that wrapper's tax applies instead of this record's (TXK-16). Who may open the account, who supervises it and how client assets are kept are the account's (brokerage-account).

source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, התשנ"ד-1994, Securities Authority's consolidated text (to 1.10.2024): s.9 (p.9), s.13(א) (p.12), s.25(א) (p.28), s.129ג (p.84, money-market funds); חוק ניירות ערך s.2 (ISA text)

regulator.notes: The Israel Securities Authority (רשות ניירות ערך) approves fund managers (s.13) and trustees (s.9), permits every prospectus (s.25(א)) and may set rules for money-market funds (s.129ג, added by Amendment 31 in force 3.10.2024). Fund law read on the Securities Authority's consolidated text (to 1.10.2024), 2026-11-07.

source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, Securities Authority's consolidated text: s.5(א)(12) (p.6, the agreement states the trustee's and manager's pay), s.80(א)(1) (p.58, expenses paid from fund assets: "שכר הנאמן ומנהל הקרן"); ISA investor guide (2017) pp. 7, 22-24

balance.notes: No regulated cap on the management fee (שכר מנהל הקרן) or the trustee fee (שכר נאמן): both are set in the fund agreement and prospectus, computed daily as an annual % of assets and deducted inside the unit price (MF-16, MF-20). The ISA's end-2025 average for money-market funds is in MF-18. Increases only on 1 January, by each manager's own undertaking in its prospectus, not by law (MF-17). The distribution fee the manager pays the bank is capped at 0.1% a year for money-market funds and comes out of the manager's fee (MF-24).

source.title: ISA, מדריך למשקיע: קרנות נאמנות (January 2017), p. 24

trustee.notes: No cap found. The 2017 guide gives 0% to 0.25% a year, average about 0.05% (dated; MF open question 6). The rate is in each fund's prospectus.

source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, Securities Authority's consolidated text: s.5(א)(7) (p.6, the maximum load in the agreement), s.42(ג) (p.35, the load is set in the prospectus and is part of the manager's pay), s.82(א)(1) (p.60)

load.notes: No regulated cap: the maximum load (הוספה) must be stated in the fund agreement, and its rate in the prospectus; the 2017 ISA guide says the vast majority of funds charge none (current share is MF open question 7).

source.title: חוק השקעות משותפות בנאמנות, Securities Authority's consolidated text: s.5(א)(7) (p.6, the agreement states whether a deduction from the redemption price is allowed), s.42(ג) (p.35), s.46 (p.36)

redemption_deduction.notes: No regulated cap: a deduction from the redemption price is allowed only if the fund agreement provides for it, with its maximum stated there (current share of funds charging one is MF open question 7).

source.title: תקנות השקעות משותפות בנאמנות (עמלת הפצה) (תיקון), התשע"ו-2016, ק"ת 7653, p.1098 (file p.10), s.2: reg. 2(ב) as substituted and reg. 2(ד) added (the regulations as made: ק"ת 6464, 2006); BoI fees rules 2008, First Schedule part 4(א)(1)

trade.notes: Under a distribution agreement a distributor may not charge the holder of money-market (type 4) units any fee for buying, holding or redeeming (reg. 2(ד)); without an agreement it may charge up to the distribution fee it could have charged the manager (reg. 2(ב)). A bank's part-4 buy/sell commission excludes mutual funds other than tracking and listed funds (BRK-16, MF-27 Leumi). A non-bank member's commission is per its tariff (MF-27: IBI up to 0.08%, minimum NIS 5, 1.7.2026).

source.title: כללי הבנקאות (שירות ללקוח) (עמלות), התשס"ח-2008, consolidated to 5.11.2024, First Schedule part 4(א)(5) note (2)

custody.notes: At a bank: no securities custody fee (דמי ניהול פיקדון ניירות ערך) may be charged on a money-market fund as defined in the Joint Investment Trust regulations. Under a distribution agreement, a distributor that is not an investment marketer may charge the holder nothing for buying, holding or redeeming money-market units (MF-26, reg. 2(ד)). Most non-bank TASE members are investment marketers, outside those regulations, and no rule limits their custody fee on money-market units (BRK-17, BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26): there the tariff applies as published (MF-27 examples).

labels: per-fund tax track: 2 of 73 money-market funds are taxable (TXS-24); taxable fund computed as 15% of nominal interest at fund level, the individual's rate as circular 7/2003 s.2.1.1 says (TXS-11)

lawful_exit.text: any trading day: an order that reaches the clearing house before the fund's designated hour is executed at that day's price, a later one at the next pricing day's price (MF-10); the redemption money reaches the holder's account on the day the distributor must pass the order to the clearing house in a fund whose investment policy keeps foreign securities at no more than 10% of net assets, and on the next trading day in any other fund (MF-11, prices regulations reg. 15; MF open question 4 closed 2026-10-26); since TASE moved to Monday to Friday on 5.1.2026 a fund limited in foreign securities also takes orders on a Friday, executed on the Sunday at Friday's closing prices with the units or cash usually in the account on the Monday, and a fund not limited in foreign securities takes them Monday to Thursday only (MF-68, BRK-29); each fund's hour is in its prospectus, 16:00 Monday to Thursday and 13:00 or 12:30 on a Friday in the shekel money-market funds of seven of the nine collected managers (MF-69)

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.88 definition "מכירה" (Tax Authority's text, p.148): "לרבות חליפין, ויתור, הסבה, העברה, הענקה, מתנה, פדיון"

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Redeeming one fund to buy another, or selling units to move money, is a sale: the real gain is taxed (withheld) even if the money never leaves the account. No order under s.101A(a)(12) deeming exempt-fund units sold and repurchased was found (TXS open question 9).

eligibility.text: whoever holds a securities account (held_in), through the distributor; most funds have no minimum investment, though a distributor may set its own account minimum or minimum commission

protection.text: fund assets belong to the trustee for the unit holders, separate from the manager's and the trustee's own property, and cannot be attached; the trustee supervises the manager; if the manager or trustee fails, the fund moves to another manager; the ISA directive limits the fund to short, highly rated shekel or FX assets with an average life of at most 90 days; market losses are not protected, there is no state guarantee, and redemptions can be suspended for a few trading days; how the account keeps the units is the account's (brokerage-account)
